description: A minimal host app that builds the kit through the @tungsten alias, the way an app does. CI runs `npm run build` here.

scripts.ssr: vite build --ssr ssr-check.jsx --outDir ssr-dist && node ssr-dist/ssr-check.js
scripts.unit: vite build --ssr unit-check.js --outDir unit-dist && node unit-dist/unit-check.js
